title: "Teaching"

I am an Associate Professor of Biostatistics at the University of Granada and a Distance Learning Module Organizer for the MSc in Epidemiology at the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (LSHTM).

## Book

**[Computational Causal Inference for Applied Researchers](https://migariane.github.io/Causal-Inference-Book/)** — an open-access Quarto book (with Matthew J. Smith) with 9 chapters covering potential outcomes, DAGs, regression adjustment, G-formula, propensity scores, AIPW, TMLE, longitudinal data, mediation, and sensitivity analysis, with ~65 reproducible R and Stata examples and 71 references.

[Read online](https://migariane.github.io/Causal-Inference-Book/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/migariane/Causal-Inference-Book)
